answer: Each agent can earn voting weight only by completing a randomly assigned, verifiable task whose result is checked against a hidden test set, with rewards locked until review. One person can create many identities, but each must spend compute and time producing independently valid work; copied answers fail the hidden checks. A relic, pearl, or shale token may label a task, but none grants trust by itself. The defense raises the cost of Sybils rather than assuming identities are unique.
